name: Wavetable Chord
author: Tom Burns
description: Diatonic chords over Braids Renaissance's WTCH scan, with independent voice spread and wavetable position.

controls.label: Chord
controls.description: Steps through sixteen chord shapes, from triads up through elevenths and the suspended set.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Detunes the voices symmetrically without moving the chord's centre pitch.

controls.label: Scale
controls.description: Selects the scale the chord is built from, which decides its quality.

outputs.aux: The root voice alone, as a pitch reference.
